---
title: "wxylib"
subtitle: "GDAL's modular ideas as small Rust crates, checked cell for cell against GDAL"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

wxylib takes the ideas inside GDAL (grids, georeferencing, chunked reads,
warping, virtual datasets), gives each one its own small home, and builds
on existing crates (async-tiff, zarrs, Icechunk, rwarp) rather than
replacing them. It is pre-release: nothing is on crates.io yet and APIs
will change.

![Every dataset sits on one ladder, from a bare array to a table of features. R1 to R3 warp today.](img/spectrum.svg){fig-alt="The R0 to R6 raster-vector spectrum, with R1 to R3 warped today, R3' modelled, R4 to R6 planned"}

## Companion reading

wxylib's grid model comes from two of its author's projects:
[Regular in what?](https://hypertidy.github.io/regular-in-what/), a short
book on grids, coordinates and the curvilinear confusion, and
[playproj](https://github.com/hypertidy/playproj), map projections, cells
and index space drawn the way they are built.
